text.p: Bonds gained in line with the European trend, with the 10 year cash spread with the German Bund remaining rock steady around 70 basis points.
Despite being off early highs, traders said that the market may not have exhausted all its potential upside, particularly if U.S. Treasuries rise again.
"The market remains well sustained, keeping in step with Spain," said one trader.
"We are going to remain "buyer" in the medium to long term part of the curve and if the Treasuries lend a hand, prices could even rise more," added another.
